chain.description: Chain the token lives on (DEFAULT_TOKENS chain).

coingeckoId.description: CoinGecko id, or null when the token is unknown to CoinGecko (its price then shows "Price unavailable" — never a guessed price). All 21 defaults have one.

coingeckoPlatform.description: CoinGecko platform slug for the token's chain (COINGECKO_PLATFORM_FOR_CHAIN). Null when CoinGecko lists no platform for the chain — a token there can still be verified by 1inch / Uniswap, just never by CoinGecko.

contract.description: Canonical contract address: checksummed for EVM, base58 for TRON, base58 for Solana, base64 for TON Jettons.

notes.description: Present only when something is missing or exceptional.

priceFallback.description: Fallback leg when the CoinGecko quote is not fresh (fetchTokenPrices): DexScreener for EVM/Solana/TRON chains in DEXSCREENER_CHAIN_FOR_CHAIN, TonAPI for TON Jettons, null when no fallback covers the chain.

priceSource.description: Primary price source (tokenPriceRequests kind): 'coingecko' when the token has a CoinGecko id, else the fallback leg.

tokenKey.description: Identity key `${chain}:${contract}` with the contract lowercased (tokenKey).

verifiedSource.description: Which trusted list verified this token (verificationSourceOf): 'curated' for the in-repo defaults, else the recorded source, else 'coingecko' when a CoinGecko id is set. Null when unverified.

description: Schema for registry/tokens.json — the 21 default tokens, generated by apps/web/scripts/generate-android-registry.mjs from apps/web/src/wallet/tokens.ts and token-prices.ts. Never hand-edit the JSON; the generator validates its output against this schema on every run.

chains.description: Distinct chains the tokens live on.

generated.description: Generated-file notice: do not edit by hand.

generatedAt.description: UTC timestamp of generation. Ignored by --check (wall-clock values would otherwise read as drift).

sourceCommit.description: Last commit that touched any data source file (git log -1 over the sources). Null when git is unavailable.

sourceDirty.description: True when any data source file had uncommitted changes at generation time. Null when git is unavailable.

version.description: Export version, starting at 1. Bump on any breaking shape change.
